about: Every host, port and protocol a cmux NEXT client (the Mac app, its daemon, the iPhone app) reaches for relay and connectivity, for firewalls that allow only listed hosts. The one source: docs/network-requirements.md is rendered from it and tests/test_network_allowlist.py checks it against the code (python3 tests/test_network_allowlist.py --write rewrites the doc). Ultra-connectivity ledger row 80, RFD 0142 item O7.

cloudflare.note: Cloudflare's published ranges. Every host with ips "cloudflare" answered inside them on the fetch date (Workers custom domains, workers.dev, R2 custom domains, Cloudflare Realtime TURN and STUN). Cloudflare changes them rarely and says so on that page.

own_pops.slot: RFD 0166 step 3 boxes, filled when bought

peer_to_peer: A direct path between your own devices (iroh, WebRTC) goes to the other device's address on a UDP port chosen at run time, so no host or port can be listed for it. Where outbound UDP is blocked, the same session goes through a relay above (tcp/443) instead: slower, never broken.
